hero.subtitle: Entering AI wa subete no kodo ga nintei, kiroku, saketeiru sekaitsuki na komando hyomen desu. Software, AI agent, enterprise platform wo hitotsu no orchestration layer ni tougo shimasu.

governance.label: Zettai Shihai
governance.description: Shi ga shirei wo shuppatsu shimasu. OmniHub wa subete no setsuzoku sareta shisutemu wo jitsujikan no kashisei to tomo ni orchestration shimasu. Koudo wa kiroku sa re, agent wa tsuisa sa re, kekka wa traceable desu.

naturalLanguage.title: Shizen gengo no shirei

capabilityRouting.title: Capability-matched routing

override.title: Dare demo no agent wo sunawani override

reversible.label: Kenpekitekina Kozo
reversible.description: Rollback wo senmon gendai ni dai ichi rui no sonozeiki kougaku no genpon toshite kensan sareta tada futatsu no enterprise AI platform. Warui ketsudan wa senba sa rezu, anata wa sore wo kanzen ni undo shimasu.

rollback.title: One-click rollback
rollback.desc: Hitotsu no komei de dore demo no agent action ya workflow shisutemu wo gyakujun shimasu. Seiri wa hitsuyou arimasen.

blastRadius.title: Blast radius containment
blastRadius.desc: OmniHub wa denpan risk wo kenshutsu shi, kaskade suru mae ni sesshoku sareta shisutemu ni shippai wo hokan shimasu.

compensating.title: Compensating transactions
